title: This Strategy is Incredible in Reality Fracture Draft!!!
event: FRA early access event (he thanks Wizards for the free preview access at 0:04-0:08; event name not shown on screen)
source: frames read from data/videos/raw/9nAjtt_8TjA (tools/video_draft.py frames grab with --grab-crop, stacked or read singly); every pack list comes from images that displayed; the 40-card deck screen at 16:04 and the 47-card screen at 14:44 account for all 42 picks (the three picked basics are inferred by count); transcript from YouTube auto captions, card names corrected; nothing past 16:05 read

colour_path.quote: I'm going to try to probably take the Mindseeker Oculus.
I don't really want to dip into a second color is the thing, but it's not like I'm like sticking to blue for anything crazy good.
Getting really rewarded for kind of sticking to my guns here.
we aren't committed fully to white. We only have three white cards.
white blue is a good spot to end up.
I think I'm just pretty set on my blue white deck now.
So, this deck is done after two packs.

picks.reasoning: Takes Mindseeker Oculus, which he has been very impressed with: irritating to deal with, and Empower Jace 4 is a lot of value. Memory Trap is good removal and second; Jiang Yanggu third, then maybe Gideon the Oathless (which only does damage if they try to kill it).

considered.Gideon the Oathless: fun to try but 'not doing anything crazy unless they try to kill him'; maybe over Jiang Yanggu
considered.Gideon's Memorial: discard mode (two mana, four damage to an attacker or blocker) 'isn't the best deal'

quotes: I'm going to try to probably take the Mindseeker Oculus. I've been very impressed with this card. It's just really irritating to deal with.

picks.reasoning: Fblthp for cheap card draw ('cheap plays that are decent late'); flyers make it easier to connect. Variable Chaser (a three-mana 2/3 flier with prowess, solid on its own) and Gallia, Tragic Host are the alternatives; he stays blue.

considered.Variable Chaser: solid three-mana 2/3 flying prowess; Arc of Fortune half sometimes does something
considered.Konstrari Improviser: pretty solid, 'sometimes if you have stuff to ramp'
considered.Emergency Phytomedic: some utility sometimes but 'kind of a low impact card'

picks.plan: Blue so far: 'I might as well stick to blue for now. Just get more card draw.'
quotes: I think I go Fblthp, then maybe Gallia, then maybe Variable Chaser.
I might as well stick to blue for now. Just get more card draw.

picks.reasoning: Protege's Awakening (Empower Jace 6 and draw a card): a really good card he has not been taking highly enough; cheaper and easier to use than Way of the Wildspeaker (five mana 4/4 draw-a-card, which makes Mindseeker Oculus a 2/1 plus a 4/4). He does not want to dip into a second colour yet.

considered.Way of the Wildspeaker: also seems really good, but green and he does not want a second colour

picks.plan: Blue; 'maybe I don't stick too heavy just to blue'; not sticking to blue for anything crazy good.
quotes: I think Protege's Awakening is a really good card and I have not been taking it highly enough.
I don't really want to dip into a second color is the thing

picks.reasoning: Hapatra is 'so far from what I'm doing right now'; he considers No Admittance instead, then takes Koth of the Homestead over Campus Crier: it can be an engine by itself and gains life.

considered.Hapatra, the Desert Fang: far from what he is doing

quotes: I might just take Koth of the Homestead. I like this card. It can like be kind of an engine all by itself. Gains you some life.

picks.reasoning: Arni, Humble Scribe over Infinite Coursework (which he likes but rates a little below Arni); 'gives myself some flexibility'. There is a kill spell if he wanted red. Stick to blue for now.

considered.Infinite Coursework: also likes it, Arni a little better maybe
considered.Terminal Criticism: a kill spell if he wanted to go more red

quotes: Yeah, let's just take the Arni. Stick to blue for now.

picks.reasoning: Between Last Gasp (great) and Tomik, a really good two-drop that plays well with Fblthp; since he already has Koth, he takes Tomik. Two-power fliers for two are just good.

considered.Bestial Incursion: an option; blue does not feel the most open but he has four really good blue cards

picks.plan: Blue does not feel the most open, but four really good blue cards so far.
quotes: I think it's between Last Gasp and Tomik. And since we already have the Koth, I think we're going to just take the Tomik.
Two ones for two are just good when they have flying.

picks.reasoning: A Desperate Futurescribe arrives: 'we are off to the races', rewarded for sticking to his guns; good synergy with the empower cards, which help surveil. Some black-red stuff coming around.

considered.Campus Crier: another one, but Futurescribe is better

picks.plan: White-blue; sticking to blue-white; 'red and green may be open, especially green might be open. We will just stick to what we have'.
quotes: Beautiful. We get a Desperate Futurescribe. We are off to the races. Getting really rewarded for kind of sticking to my guns here.

picks.reasoning: Protege's Awakening then Unsummon is a good little line: draw a bunch of cards, then bounce one of their things to buy back time.
quotes: It's nice when you can go like Protege's Awakening and then Unsummon.

picks.reasoning: A two-drop in colour. Not a card he would want to play in a perfect world, but a fine one.
quotes: Get ourselves a two drop in color.
Maybe I wouldn't want to play Cryotheory in a perfect world, but it's a fine card.

picks.reasoning: Takes the land over Emergency Phytomedic: not fully committed to white (only three white cards) and Phytomedic is not crazy in white-blue, so the green land keeps a green dip open. He does not expect to miss the Phytomedic.

considered.Emergency Phytomedic: 'cute with' his deck but he does not think he will miss it

picks.plan: White-blue with a possible green dip: 'we aren't committed fully to white. We only have three white cards.'
quotes: So yeah, let's take the land in case we want to dip into green.

picks.reasoning: Tries Eye of Jace: a nice surveil payoff that eventually deals some damage.
picks.plan: White-blue ('a good spot to end up'); nine playable cards after pack one's first half.
quotes: Okay, maybe I'll try Eye of Jace here. Real nice surveil payoff.

picks.reasoning: Sphinx's Approach for raw card draw; goes in the speculative pile with the land.
quotes: Then I'm going to take Sphinx's Approach. Just raw card draw.

picks.reasoning: Not discussed; the Aspirant is the only spell left. Pool then has several legendaries (Arni, Tomik, Koth), so a decent chance Fateshaper Aspirant works.
quotes: We have a couple of legendaries. We have Arni, Tomik, Koth. So, decent chance we can get this to work out.

picks.reasoning: Last card; basic Plains.
quotes: Okay, I like where we're at after pack one.

picks.reasoning: Tetsuko plays well with Mindseeker Oculus, Tomik and Cryotheory Adept: a really nice aggressive drop. There is a removal spell in the pack but he would rather be proactive than reactive right now. Blessed Ghoul is a bit of a combo with Arni (discard it over and over). He would not mind Memory Trap.

considered.Memory Trap: 'I wouldn't mind Memory Trap' but takes Tetsuko
considered.Blessed Ghoul: fine; combo with Arni, discard and get it back repeatedly
considered.removal spell (not named): would rather be proactive than reactive

picks.plan: White-blue after pack one: 'I like where we're at after pack one.'
quotes: Pack two, there's Tetsuko, which I really like.
I'd rather just focus on being proactive than reactive right now.

picks.reasoning: Will keep taking Mindseeker Oculus whenever he sees it: so strong. Teyo is good too. Another Fateshaper Aspirant, but he will only stick with the one; Tetsuko is legendary so Fateshaper Aspirant can return it.
quotes: And now I think I'm just going to keep taking Mindseeker Oculuses whenever I see them. This card is so so strong.

picks.reasoning: Between Kindred Judgment (choose a creature type and kill everything else, strong but a seven-drop) and Prudent Fateseer. Since he will be surveilling a lot he can surveil away lands, and Prudent Fateseer looks like a really good card with plenty in his deck that works with it. Tam's Resistance is probably a fine one.

considered.Kindred Judgment: strong ('I choose Humongous and kill everything else') but a seven-drop

quotes: it's between Kindred and Judgment. Like I just like choose a creature type. ... That's pretty strong, but it's a seven drop.
Prudent Fateseer here just seems like a really good card for my deck.

picks.reasoning: Teyo over Cryotheory Adept. Nice that he has no duplicate legendary: one copy of each is pretty good. Better than the Ghoul and better than Twinned Vision.
quotes: Now we'll take Teyo over Cryotheory Adept. It's kind of nice. I don't have multiple copies of any legendary.

picks.reasoning: A four-drop; works if he has equipment (he has none) or things to target, things like Seed Suture. His spells are not ones that target. Takes the Semester Foreseer.

considered.Danitha, Sword of Hope: works with equipment or spells that target; he has few targeting spells
considered.Emergency Phytomedic: Seed Suture would be really good with it

quotes: So, let's just take the Semester Foreseer.

picks.reasoning: Great pickup: Repurposed Enforcer helps him be proactive and empowers Jace when it attacks; a really good two-drop. Predictive Preparations could be fine, Hajaira is good for sure, Way of the Mentor not the best.
picks.plan: White-blue: 'I'm just pretty set on my blue white deck now.'
quotes: Repurposed Enforcer helps me be proactive. When I attack, I empower Jace. Great, great card.
I think I'm just pretty set on my blue white deck now.

picks.reasoning: Another Desperate Futurescribe; it worked well with Eye of Jace.
picks.plan: White-blue; 18 playables halfway through pack two.
quotes: Just going to take another Desperate Futurescribe.
I've got 18 playables so far and it's only halfway through pack two.

picks.reasoning: Great pickup: even as a four-drop it is pretty nice if he can put some counters on, a huge vigilance flier with prowess.
quotes: It's just a huge vigilance flyer with prowess like that.

picks.reasoning: Another Unsummon, don't mind; could be a perfect Unsummon deck, even bouncing his own Mindseeker Oculus.

The deck is done after two packs; he wants one or two hard removal spells and then more power through synergy. Plan for All Outcomes: any non-creature spell empowers Jace, and he uses that to surveil. Otherwise it is Blossom-Blessed Angel, but he already has a few big fliers at four mana.

considered.Blossom-Blessed Angel: he already has a few big fliers at four mana

Anytime I cast a non-creature spell, I'll get to get my Jace going and then I can use that to surveil.

picks.reasoning: He asked for a hard removal spell and gets Your Fate Ends Here: kill spell plus surveil, just what the deck wants. He would play Ruric Thar as a giant flier at the top end. There is also a land (Fatehold Annex) that hopefully wheels.

considered.Ruric Thar, Biomagus: would definitely play as a giant flier at the top end, but removal that surveils is what the deck wants

quotes: I said I wanted a hard removal spell and I get Your Fate Ends Here. Kill spell plus surveil. Just perfect card for my deck.

picks.reasoning: A good counter spell for his deck. While deckbuilding he considers cutting Semester Foreseer for it: creature count is at 16, so he is fine cutting a clunky creature, and he has about six two-drops to play on turn two.
picks.plan: White-blue; thinking about cuts for the final build.
quotes: Okay, there is a Countersculpt now. Seems like a good counter spell for my deck.

quotes: Love Way of the Healer. Minus two, create a two two and surveil one for four mana. It's pretty good.

picks.reasoning: Maybe he wants two copies of Eye of Jace; does not want Way of the Cryomancer (not many instants and sorceries). Plays two Eye of Jace for now.

quotes: Maybe I want two Eye of Jaces. I don't think I want Way of the Cryomancer. I don't have that many instants and sorceries.

quotes: I think I have enough two drops. I'm just going to take the Ruric Thar.
